thread:
Emma: Heads-up — Polaris Health running a 4-week POC starting today. Sales request: temporary burst uplift to validate peak-latency behavior. Asking for a short-term promotional burst discount.

Tomas: Tech summary: they'll run mixed pools. Baseline reserved target = 10x A100 equiv for steady traffic after POC. POC ramp: 72h hammer, then steadies. Want burst headroom up to 20x A100 equiv for first 28 days. Autoscale min=2, max=20 while in burst. KV warm expected within first 48h.

Emma: Sales asked for 25% off standard burst rate during the POC and asked us to absorb overage above a hard cap. They proposed $22k max promotional liability for Redwood. If they convert to 12mo commit within 30 days we credit the promo back into month 1.

PricingBot: Quick math: 
Reserved 10x A100 equiv: $45,000/mo (example)
Standard burst: $18 / GPU-hour -> requested 25% -> $13.5 / GPU-hour
Estimated 4-week excess (10 extra GPUs): 10 * 24 * 28 * $13.5 = ~$90,720 uncapped
With $22,000 cap -> Redwood covers the remainder of promotional discount.

Priya: Finance notes: We can approve a limited promotional burst discount with conditions: (1) signed LOI or trial agreement before promo activation; (2) hard cap of $22k; (3) conversion to a 12mo commit within 30 days to retain credit; (4) retro billing at standard burst rate if conversion isn't accepted within window for any usage beyond cap. Also require CSM acceptance criteria defined up front.

Olivia: Deal desk conditional approval pending LOI text and routing enforcement. Need explicit enforcement plan from infra (hard burst throttle or routing policy) so we never bill more than cap in promo.

Tomas: Routing policy I'll put in infra, sample snippet below that we'll enforce at edge: 
```
route:
  reserved_pool: "polaris-10x-a100"
  burst_allowed: "20x-a100-eq"
  burst_hard_cap_usd: 22000
  autoscale:
    min_nodes: 2
    max_nodes: 20
```
I'll post this to infra once LOI is signed.

Jonah: CSM here. We'll own LOI + conversion checklist. Need target SLOs (p95 latency, error budget), instrumentation hooks, and KV warm metrics capture. We'll sign off after first 7 days review.

Emma: Olivia — can you confirm wording you want in the LOI for conversion timeline and promo cap? I'll draft and ping legal.

Olivia: Draft asks: (a) LOI with commitment intent and conversion window 30 days, (b) promo applies only to first 28 days of POC, (c) $22k max promo credit, (d) usage beyond cap billed at list rates retroactively if not converted, (e) CSM sign-off clause required for credit. If agreed, deal desk approves. :+1:

Priya: Addendum for finance: require payment method on file and team lead signature.

Emma: Great — I'll draft and drop LOI in this thread in ~2 hours. Tagging @Tomas for routing enforcement and @Jonah for CSM checklist. :rocket:
